text:
incident-bot: PAGE: P1 - High prefix cache miss rate causing elevated token p95 latency in us-west1 inference pool. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-012

priya (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Starting collection: pv/pod logs + cache metrics. ETA 2m.

sam (engineer): looking at redis proxy metrics — saw a spike in prefix-miss-rate at 13:28 UTC. Sending snapshot.

sam (engineer): metrics link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/cache?orgId=1&from=2026-03-10T13:20&to=2026-03-10T13:50  (hit-rate dropped 87%->12% in ~3m)

alex (sre): tagging. Which models affected? any dedicated customers?

priya (oncall): affected across models: gpt-redwood-1 variants for short prompts. top tenants: acme-corp, betaapps, internal-dev. customer-impact: slow responses, some timeouts.

jordan (infra): collecting KV cache logs from nodes. Piping top keys and TTLs. paste:
```
# /var/log/kvcache/kvcache-collector.log
2026-03-10T13:27:58Z NODE=us-west1-a shard=7 prefix_hits=42 prefix_misses=3892 cache_size_mb=620
2026-03-10T13:28:01Z NODE=us-west1-a shard=7 prefix_hits=35 prefix_misses=4010 cache_size_mb=615
2026-03-10T13:28:05Z NODE=us-west1-b shard=3 prefix_hits=120 prefix_misses=4100 cache_size_mb=600
```

priya (oncall): hypothesis1: cache invalidation job ran accidentally / misconfigured leading to prefix TTLs cleared. hypothesis2: sudden skew in client prefixes leading to low reuse. hypothesis3: backend mix of quantized model variant causing different cache keys.

sam (engineer): found cron for cache-ttl-refresh ran at 13:26 in us-west scheduled on canary alone — looks normal. However, noticed cache invalidation API returning 200 for bulk-invalidate request at 13:27 from deploy pipeline: `POST /cache/invalidate` body size ~2.4MB. logs:
```
2026-03-10T13:27:12Z deploy-service POST /cache/invalidate user=deploy-bot target=us-west1 status=200 size=2401823
```

alex (sre): can we revert that invalidation? is there an undo? @jordan

jordan (infra): invalidate is immediate, but we can trigger incremental rebuild by seeding hot prefixes from recent traffic stored in hot-prefix table. Running seeder now: `./tools/seed_hot_prefixes --region=us-west1 --since=1h`.

priya (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) block further invalidation calls with WAF rule, (2) seed hot prefixes, (3) increase cache TTL to 4h for high-frequency prefixes, (4) add temporary routing to warm pool. Starting 1 & 2 now.

maria (cust-suc): reaching out to Acme and BetaApps to inform about degraded latency. will update.

sam (engineer): seeder completed. initial hit-rate after seeding improved to ~45% within 7m. CLI output:
```
SEEDER: seeded 5.2k prefixes to kvcache in us-west1; estimated hit_rate_pre=12% hit_rate_post=46%
```

priya (oncall): rolling WAF rule to block /cache/invalidate from deploy-bot — applied to us-west1 at 13:35 UTC :thumbsup: 

alex (sre): confirming metrics now p95 latency down from 2.1s -> 750ms. Still not at baseline. continuing to monitor.

sam (engineer): timeline notes appended to incident doc. Adding hypothesis tracker. Current hypotheses:
- H1: accidental bulk invalidation from deploy pipeline (evidence: deploy-service log)
- H2: traffic profile changed causing low reuse (evidence: prefix cardinality spike in grafana)
- H3: bug in KV cache shard mapping causing inefficient key distribution (no direct evidence yet)

priya (oncall): handoff at 14:00 to alex (next oncall). Summary: mitigation in place (WAF + seeder + TTL bump), partial recovery. Follow-ups: durable audit of invalidation API, add guardrails to prevent >1MB invalidation payloads, scheduled RCA.

alex (sre): taking over. noted.

jordan (infra): attaching exporter snippets and commands used to compute hit-rate timeline:
```
# compute hit-rate
curl -s 'https://metrics/api/query?m=prefix_miss_rate&from=13:20&to=13:50&region=us-west1' | jq '.data[] | {ts, hit_rate: 1 - (misses/requests)}'
```

sam (engineer): log excerpt from model-serving showing fallback to uncached path:
```
2026-03-10T13:29:02Z model-serve pid=3421 INFO prefix_lookup miss key=md-usr-32.. fallback=kv-fetch backend_latency=300ms
2026-03-10T13:29:03Z model-serve pid=3421 WARN over_capacity cache_fetch_retries=3
```

maria (cust-suc): Acme responded: they saw increased latencies and one client-side retry spike. They've paused a heavy batch job for now. Will coordinate postmortem shared with them.

alex (sre): action items (assigned): sam - reproduce invalidation call + write small harness to assert limits; jordan - add rate limit to invalidate API + telemetry; priya - write customer impact note; platform - RCA doc + timeline + postmortem.

priya (oncall): closing loop for now — incident to sev2 in timeline, keeping incident page open for RCA. If anyone sees regression ping oncall.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated severity=high impacted_regions=[us-west1] started=1748123456 mitigated=1748126250

alex (sre): final note: recommend we add alert on prefix_hit_rate drop >20% sustained for 3m and block invalidation by default in prod unless explicit env=force.

priya (oncall): thanks all. handing back to follow-ups list in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
